name: aatgrid
title: Australian Antarctic Territory grid (aatgrid v0.3)
description: UTM south family with one lattice shared by every zone: origin 140000/20000, 720 px tiles at any resolution, aligned to Sentinel-2 10/20 m pixels.

alignment.note: S2 10 m and 20 m pixel lattices coincide with aatgrid's (verified against 132 MGRS codes, aatgrid R/mgrs.R).
aatgrid origin is 20 mod 60 on both axes; S2 60 m ulx is 0 mod 60 and uly is 40 mod 60 in southern zones (1e7 % 60 = 40).

notes: Levels are not fixed: tile size is 720 * res for any res, and nesting between two resolutions is their ratio when it is an integer (aatgrid nesting_factor()).
negative = false follows the explorer ('negative indices do not exist'); the R functions themselves accept negative indices.

No lon/lat extent or zone list: the README's 42S-58S is stale, and crsgrid seeds domains from the user's motivation (AOI, purpose) rather than hardcoding limits. The 1.2 scale-factor envelope is the explorer's default view setting, kept as a default rather than a limit.
